messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — SEV2: Model quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp in dedicated-pool-east-1. Trigger: perf-eval delta >25% on prompt-suite A. Runbook: /runbooks/model-regression. Assigned: oncall-ml.

sarah.h: Oncall-ml here — investigating. I saw the alert at ~10:42PT. Initial triage: regression appears after last quant/profile rollout 10:30PT (quant_profile_v2). Affected: 100% of AcmeCorp traffic on dedicated-acme-01. No other tenants flagged by monitors.

acme-tom: Thanks for the quick ping. We're seeing hallucinations and factual errors in prod calls. Impacting key customer workflow (invoice extraction). Appreciate ETA.

sarah.h: Copy. @acme-tom — we will prioritize rollback canary first. @eng-ml tagging for kernel/quantization assistance.

ops-greg: Verified infra: dedicated-acme-01 GPU utilization normal, no OOMs, no restarts. Latency stable. This looks like a quality/regression-only issue tied to quant_profile_v2.

jordan.r: Adding logs from the model-service on one replica:

```
[2026-03-15T17:31:05Z] INFO model-infer: loaded profile quant_profile_v2
[2026-03-15T17:41:12Z] WARN eval: bleu_drop=0.32 on prompt-suite A
[2026-03-15T17:42:00Z] ERROR output-check: high_confidence hallucination detected for tenant acme
```

mike.l: I can take handoff at 10:55PT. Plan: 1) Canary revert to quant_profile_v1 on 5% traffic (single shard) 2) Validate perf/eval metrics and sample outputs for 10m 3) If stable, promote to full rollback on dedicated-acme-01 4) Notify customer and close.

sarah.h: Handoff to @mike.l accepted. I'll remain available for escalation. Leaving notes in incident doc.

mike.l: Running canary update now. Command:

```
redwoodctl tenant update-profile --tenant acme --pool dedicated-acme-01 --profile quant_profile_v1 --percent 5
```

mike.l: Canary applied to shard acme-shard-3. Observing request traces and quick evals. Pinging @acme-tom for validation.

acme-tom: Confirmed sample looks better on canary. Scores improved on our internal checks. Please proceed if metrics look good on your side.

mike.l: Perf check after 7m on canary: perf-eval delta down to 3% vs baseline. Output samples look sane. No infra regressions.

eng-ml: Good signal. Two notes: if quant_profile_v1 uses older kernel, we might need to recompile kernels for full pool restart to avoid transient cold miss latency. We'll standby to accelerate.

mike.l: Ok proceeding to full rollback. Change set: update tenant profile binding + restart model workers in pool then trigger a controlled drain. Command to promote:

```
redwoodctl tenant promote-profile --tenant acme --pool dedicated-acme-01 --profile quant_profile_v1
systemctl restart redwood-model-worker@dedicated-acme-01 --no-block
```

ops-greg: I'll coordinate restarts to avoid simultaneous restarts across all replicas; rolling restart 1-by-1.

sarah.h: Noted — follow rolling restart runbook steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollback (shared with oncall).

jordan.r: After first two replicas restarted: logs show model loaded quant_profile_v1 and kernel fallback completed. No elevated latencies.

mike.l: Full promotion complete at ~11:12PT. Running 15m smoke evals and customer probes.

acme-tom: We're seeing restoration of expected outputs in production. Thanks. Will run additional tests for the next 30m and report.

eng-ml: Will monitor for regression reappearing — looking at weight-quantization mapping edge-cases; planning a postmortem to understand why quant_profile_v2 slipped past canary tests.

sarah.h: Customer impact summary for postmortem: severity SEV2, regression affected AcmeCorp only, caused degraded output quality for ~40 minutes (10:30–11:12PT) until rollback. No data leak, no infra failure, isolated to dedicated pool config update.

mike.l: Action items captured: 1) Revert done, 2) Expand pre-rollout evals for tenant-specific prompt suites, 3) Add tenant-specific canary gating in pipeline, 4) Eng-ML to run deeper quantization audit.

acme-tom: Appreciate the fast response and transparency. Please share postmortem and timeline when available.

sarah.h: Will draft postmortem and link here. Closing incident once customer confirms full recovery (cc @eng-ml). :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update logged. Severity: SEV2 -> mitigated. Incident ticket: INC-1769345678.

mike.l: Leaving final note — recommend quarantining profile quant_profile_v2 from auto-promote until root cause is clear. :+1:

eng-ml: Agreed. We'll create a patch branch for quant_profile_v2 repro and tests.

sarah.h: Thanks everyone. Handoff to normal ops.
